name: What should I expect during the home remodeling process?

mainEntity.name: What should I expect during the home remodeling process?

acceptedAnswer.text: The remodeling process typically begins with initial consultation and design, followed by a detailed proposal and contract. Once approved, permits are secured, and a project schedule is established. Construction phases involve demolition, rough-ins (plumbing, electrical), inspections, installation of finishes (cabinets, flooring), and final walk-throughs. Throughout, expect regular communication from your contractor regarding progress and any necessary adjustments.
acceptedAnswer.description: Expect consultation, design, permitting, construction phases including demolition and installation, and regular communication throughout your remodel.
